card.name: "of" after surge or flow nouns
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after a noun for a sudden rush or flow, such as influx, rush, flow, surge, flush, stream or wave. It is also seen on "wave" after "shock".

modes.label: Influx/surge + of
modes.description: "of" follows a noun meaning a large arrival or movement of things or people.
modes.example: This resulted in the influx<< of>> satirical British Punch cartoons and early

modes.label: Flow or flush + of
modes.description: "of" follows a liquid or current movement noun, including in instructions.
modes.example: After the flush<< of>> the syringe has been completed, perform
